title: RVLRY: four playable visual directions
summary: Compare Pub Trivia, Bookclub, Recess and Observatory; reply here with a direction and details to keep.
body:
Four isolated, interactive demos are ready. The Android app keeps its current design while you compare them.

**Open:** JNAS → Media → DropBox → RVLRY-design-demos → index.html. Alternatively download RVLRY-design-demos.zip, extract the whole folder and open index.html. Keep the assets alongside the HTML. All demos work offline.

Kestrel displays the review and collects answers; its article format does not run the interactive demos. The folder also includes screenshots for a quick comparison.

| Direction | What to look for |
| --- | --- |
| After-Hours Social / Pub Trivia | Warm slate, amber, condensed lettering and paper tickets. |
| Margin Note / Bookclub | Parchment, sage, editorial serif and restrained terracotta. |
| Recess & Construction Paper | Cobalt, yellow, cut-paper shapes, chunky lettering and pressable shadows. |
| Midnight Observatory | Indigo, brass, engraved lettering and restrained cosmic motion. |

Each uses the same picker → settings → teams → handoff → timed play → pause → recap → results flow. Try Correct, Skip, returning a skipped word and Hint. The Demo controls jump between screens and enable long names/four teams. These are representative design studies with sample words and no saved-game persistence.

Both new Android games are being integrated independently of this choice. Your selection here guides a later production styling change; it does not automatically apply a theme. Answers are saved in Kestrel for the next review and do not automatically start an agent.
